correctness.rationale: Decompose ordered edge pairs: same-edge region area 2r-r² through 1; shared-vertex direct corner r²/2 or 1-(2-r)²/2; for r<=3/2 every other shortest admissible route can use at most one complete intervening edge. The additional one-bridge corner triangle contributes (r-1)²/2, counted twice for each middle-edge configuration. For this radius range corner triangles have disjoint positive-area interiors, including in triangle graphs, and route-count coefficient Q=sum_uv(d_u-1)(d_v-1), with m-S+Q=H-2S. Thus the CDF spline, one-sided derivative reconstruction m=2/F’(0+), S=m² F’’(0+)+2m, H=2S+(m²/2)(F’’(1+)-F’’(1-)). For explicit graphs E1={04,12,13,23,34}, E2={01,13,14,23,24}, m=5,S=12,H=24 versus23, giving same degree sequence and first separation just above r=1. Independently computed exact rational shortest-route polygon areas for 24 graph/radius cases, including triangle, 5-path, star, square cycle and both witnesses; all agreed. Finite checks do not replace proof for arbitrary graph size.
